title: Return Reasons and the Weighting of Marlowe Rewards Points Taken Back
content:
The reason a customer gives for a return under Returns & Exchanges sets a reason share. The reason share weights the Marlowe Rewards points taken back when that return is refunded.

## The reason share

The reason is read from the returned line: the reason recorded when the line was authorised.

| Reason given on the returned line | Reason share |
|---|---|
| defective | 75 percent |
| not as pictured | 75 percent |
| arrived too late | 90 percent |
| any other reason (for example too small, too large, changed mind, unwanted gift) | 100 percent |

## How the share acts

The reversed spend enters the points reversed multiplied by the reason share. The share is not rounded on its own.

## Illustration (hypothetical reversed spend of 80.00 USD)

| Reason on the returned line | Reversed spend as weighted |
|---|---|
| defective | 60.00 |
| not as pictured | 60.00 |
| arrived too late | 72.00 |
| too small | 80.00 |
